sequence: 1x only: load until ready (interact.load.ready-ms), library Add, wait for the waveform and quiet (interact.harness.hook-live)
clip click: empty Stems lane click deselects (Clip Gain fader disabled), then a click on the clip header (interact.click.*, interact.harness.click-live)
zoom with 1 clip: 5 x "=" then 5 x "-", one window per key (interact.zoom.1.*, interact.harness.zoom-live)
drags stopped: range, fade-in, trim start, move; 60 steps, +120 px; reset after each (interact.drag.<d>.stopped.*)

lane drag stopped: press on the clip name bar; 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; 1 step down into the next lane, then 10 steps +40 px there; 1 step back up, then 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; release; reset with Ctrl+Z (interact.drag.lane.stopped.*, interact.harness.drag-lane-live)
Home (seek to 0), then Space -> playing (interact.play.start-*, 1x: interact.harness.audio-running)
drags playing, each after Home (seek to 0): range, fade-in, trim start, move (interact.drag.<d>.playing.*)

lane drag playing, after Home (seek to 0): press on the clip name bar; 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; 1 step down into the next lane, then 10 steps +40 px there; 1 step back up, then 10 steps +40 px on its own lane; release; reset with Ctrl+Z (interact.drag.lane.playing.*, interact.harness.drag-lane-live)

1x only: click the clip header, Ctrl+D x 29 (interact.harness.clips-30), zoom with 30 clips: keys, then the in-first path (5 x "=", 5 x "-") and the out-first path (5 x "-", 5 x "=") with the zoom probe (interact.zoom.30.*, interact.zoom.30.in/out.*), Space, Home, fade-in drag on the first clip (interact.drag.fade.30.playing.*), Space, then Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100, 5 x -100) with the zoom probe (interact.zoom.30.wheel.*)

1x only, measured last: "-" until 2 clip name bars are visible (at most 16), click one name bar (setup), then click the name bar of a visible, unselected clip on the selected clip's lane, then click it again (interact.select.same-lane.30.*, interact.select.reclick.30.*, interact.harness.select-same-lane-live)

rows.scenario: load until ready
rows.note: 1x only. Navigation start to ready (library Add enabled and the preview waveform drawn), as load.ready-ms in PERF-1a. Trend only (±30 %).

rows.scenario: load + library Add click
rows.note: 1x only. React commits seen by the devtools-hook stub from the Add click until the added clip's waveform is drawn and the page is quiet; a disabled hook must fail, not report 0.

rows.scenario: Space -> playing
rows.note: 1x only. Home (seek to 0) first. 1 only when the Play button data-playing attribute is true, a tracked (non-offline) AudioContext reports state running, and at least 1 start() was recorded from the Space press until the page is quiet (at least 1 s); GATE206-S6 rule.

rows.scenario: clip click
rows.note: The Clip Gain fader is enabled after Add (the added clip is selected); an empty Stems lane click deselects: the fader is disabled. After the click on the clip header the fader is enabled and there is exactly 1 of it. The fader is always rendered, so enabled state is the selection signal.

rows.scenario: clip click
rows.note: React commits from the click until quiet (min 600 ms, then 200 ms without a commit or start(), cap 3 s).

rows.scenario: clip click
rows.note: Sum of rendered components over the click window; detail lists the per-commit sizes.

rows.scenario: clip click
rows.note: Longest Event Timing entry (>= 16 ms) in the click window; when the observer gives none, the longest long-animation-frame in the window; 0 when neither exists. detail.source names which. Trend only.

rows.scenario: zoom, 1 clip
rows.note: The Zoom (px/s) slider value rises on each of the 5 '=' keys, falls on each of the 5 '-' keys, and returns along the same values (value i equals value 10 - i), every value strictly between the slider's min and max (read before the first key; a missing min or max is a problem). The slider steps are integers, so the exact compare is valid.

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Same rule as interact.harness.zoom-live on the in-first path, from the value interact.zoom.30 returned to: the Zoom (px/s) slider moves the expected way on every key, returns along the same values, and never reaches the slider min or max.

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Maximum over the 10 keys of the Event Timing keydown duration in each key window (durationThreshold 16 ms; a key with no entry counts as 0). detail.perKey lists the 10 values. The PERF-3 exit target (keydown < 50 ms with 30 clips) is a C decision row, not an assert. Measured with the zoom probe (perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts) connected, so not strictly comparable with interact.zoom.30.key-window-longest-ms, which is measured without it.

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Median (stats.median) of the same 10 per-key keydown values. Measured with the zoom probe (perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts) connected, so not strictly comparable with interact.zoom.30.key-window-longest-ms, which is measured without it.

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Longest long-animation-frame duration over the 10 key windows; an entry counts for a key when it overlaps that key window (from the key press until quiet), so a frame that began just before the press still counts. detail.perKey lists the per-key maximum. Measured with the zoom probe (perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts) connected, so not strictly comparable with interact.zoom.30.key-window-longest-ms, which is measured without it.

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Commits over the 10 key windows / 10. detail.perKey lists the commits per key; detail.max is their maximum (the PERF-3 exit needs <= 1).

rows.scenario: zoom in-first path (5 x '=' then 5 x '-'), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Waveform path d rewrites over the 10 keys (MutationObserver from perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts: attribute d on a path inside [data-testid="arrangement-clip-waveform"]; fade and envelope paths do not count). detail.perKey lists them. The in-first path never crosses the 25 px/s waveform column band, so it rewrites nothing.

rows.note: 1x only. Added plus removed child nodes on targets inside [data-testid="arrangement-ruler"] over the 10 keys (zoom probe). detail.perKey lists them.

rows.note: 1x only. rows.scenario: zoom out-first path (5 x '-' then 5 x '='), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Commits over the 10 key windows / 10. detail.perKey lists the commits per key; detail.max is their maximum (the PERF-3 exit needs <= 1).

rows.scenario: zoom out-first path (5 x '-' then 5 x '='), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Waveform path d rewrites over the 10 keys (MutationObserver from perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts: attribute d on a path inside [data-testid="arrangement-clip-waveform"]; fade and envelope paths do not count). detail.perKey lists them. The out-first path crosses the 25 px/s column band on key 3 and back on key 8. Since PERF-3d (doc 223) a crossing rebuilds only the waveforms inside the three-viewport timeline window; a clip outside keeps its previous path until a scroll brings it into the window. At 1440x900 with 30 clips: key 3 rewrites 1, key 4 rewrites 1 (the anchored scroll brings one stale clip into the window), key 8 rewrites 1. Was 60 before PERF-3d (each crossing rewrote all 30).

rows.scenario: zoom out-first path (5 x '-' then 5 x '='), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Added plus removed child nodes on targets inside [data-testid="arrangement-ruler"] over the 10 keys (zoom probe). detail.perKey lists them.

rows.scenario: zoom Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100 then 5 x -100), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only, measured last (wheel zoom anchors on the pointer and moves scrollLeft). Pointer at the timeline scroller's left + 524 px, top + 60 px; Control held with keyboard.down/up around each mouse.wheel. The Zoom (px/s) slider falls on each of the first 5 steps and rises on each of the last 5. No symmetry or clamp rule: the wheel factor need not invert exactly.

rows.scenario: zoom Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100 then 5 x -100), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Longest long-animation-frame duration over the 10 step windows (Event Timing has no wheel entries); an entry counts for a step when it overlaps that step window. detail.perStep lists the per-step maximum. Measured with the zoom probe (perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts) connected, so not strictly comparable with interact.zoom.30.key-window-longest-ms, which is measured without it.

rows.scenario: zoom Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100 then 5 x -100), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Commits over the 10 wheel step windows / 10 (the unit says key; here each step is one Ctrl+wheel). detail.perStep lists the commits per step; detail.max is their maximum.

rows.scenario: zoom Ctrl+wheel out-first (5 x deltaY +100 then 5 x -100), 30 clips
rows.note: 1x only. Waveform path d rewrites over the 10 wheel steps (zoom probe). The path crosses the 25 px/s column band on step 4 and back on step 7. Since PERF-3d (doc 223) only the waveforms inside the three-viewport timeline window rebuild: at 1440x900 with 30 clips, 1 on step 4 and 1 on step 7. detail.perStep lists them. Was 60 before PERF-3d.
